claims.text: These are local wall/CPU/RSS/disk measurements on one machine at one time. They do not validate a strategy, prove profitability or satisfy M2 acceptance. Load, thermal state, cache warmth and other processes change the numbers; compare runs on the same idle machine instead.

host.note: local measurements on one machine at one time, from a real parquet store; load_average_at_start and load_average_at_case_start are recorded because other processes change wall time. When load is high, compare same-process ratios and the min/CPU columns before absolute seconds. One heavy job at a time is the intended condition.
